info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Loan Payment Reversal API
info.description: The Loan Payment Reversal API allows financial institutions to reverse payments associated with specific loans. This operation is crucial for correcting payment errors or processing refunds. With the ability to target individual payments by their unique identifiers, this API serves as an essential tool for loan servicing teams and customer service representatives. It enables organizations to maintain accurate records and enhance customer satisfaction in case of payment disputes or cancellations.

post.summary: Reverse a payment for a specified loan.
post.description: This operation allows you to reverse a specific payment associated with a loan. When a payment needs to be undone, this endpoint can be utilized to handle the reversal process efficiently.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to reverse a specific payment associated with a given loan. Ensure that the payment ID and loan ID are valid and that the reversal process complies with the institution's policies.

201.description: The payment reversal was successfully initiated.
